dct_description_sm: This project aimed to address climate change impacts on a local level in the community of Old Crow, the northernmost community in Yukon Territory. The three components of the project were: (1) to perform a legal analysis of the Vuntut Gwitchin First Nation Final Agreement to determine the presence of a legal basis for climate change initiatives under the Fish and Wildlife, and Land Use Planning chapters; (2) to assess the response of Umbrella Final Agreement-mandated organizations to climate change and to make recommendations for greater involvement for these organizations; and (3) to initiate stages of a climate change risk assessment and adaptation project in Old Crow (in which 14 indicators of climate change were identified), as well as the risks associated with changes related to these indicators.
